star_system.skill_level_unlocks: Skill Lv1 at 0 stars (just owning the character), Skill Lv2 at 2 stars, Skill Lv3 at 5 stars, Skill Lv4 at 7 stars. Skill level is separate from star/character level.
star_system.note: Stars 1, 4, and 7 give the same stat boost per character (e.g. Alex gets [All] Max HP +3% each time). Stars 3 and 6 each unlock a resonance slot. Star 7 gives both a stat boost AND skill level 4.

resonance.description: Resonance allows characters to equip skills from other characters you own.
resonance.unlock_at: Star 3 (+1 slot) and Star 6 (+1 slot, 2 total)
resonance.how_it_works: A 6-star character can equip 2 borrowed skills from other characters in addition to their own skill. The borrowed skill uses the level from the character who owns it.
resonance.example: A 6-star Dracoola can equip Hou Yi's Sun Piercer and Nyanja's Cloudfooted if you own those characters.
resonance.pvp_note: Phynx's Desert Tribunal is widely considered the best resonance skill for PvP.

skill_levels.2: ATK SPD +10% for 10s after a CRIT.
skill_levels.4: Guarantees a CRIT on the next attack after taking DMG.

skill_levels.1: MOV SPD +10% and periodically releases Swift Wind to push back and damage enemies.
skill_levels.2: Increases Swift Wind range and doubles Swift Wind DMG.
skill_levels.3: Swift Wind triggers an explosion on enemy contact.

skill_levels.1: Lower HP increases ATK. ATK SPD +20% for 5s after taking DMG.
skill_levels.2: ATK SPD +20% for 5s after taking DMG.
skill_levels.3: ATK PWR +20% for 10s after taking DMG.

skill_levels.1: Hela increases her own and all nearby allies' ATK by 5%.
skill_levels.2: Hela restores 1% HP to herself and all nearby allies over time.
skill_levels.3: Hela increases her own and all nearby allies' CRIT Rate by 5%.
skill_levels.4: Hela increases her own and all nearby allies' CRIT DMG by 20%.

skill_levels.1: When HP reaches 0 for the first time, 60% chance to enter [Overdraw], consuming 50%-100% of ATK. Increased ATK and MOV SPD when in [Overdraw].
skill_levels.2: Defeating monsters has a small chance of removing [Overdraw].
skill_levels.3: When [Overdraw] is active, -30% ATK and MOV SPD to surrounding monsters.
skill_levels.4: When entering [Overdraw], Overdraw HP drain range increases to [100%-150%].

skill_levels.1: Gain 1 Sunpiercer stack per boss defeated. Each stack increases attack speed by 4% (max 9 stacks).
skill_levels.2: Each Sunpiercer stack additionally increases attack by 4%.
skill_levels.3: Gain 2 Sunpiercer stacks per boss defeated and 1 stack per elite defeated.
skill_levels.4: Gain 2 Sunpiercer stacks when entering battle. Each stack additionally increases crit damage by 4%.

skill_levels.1: 50% chance to encounter the Valkyrie at the start.
skill_levels.2: Chance to get another skill when Healing is selected during Angel encounter.
skill_levels.3: Chance that Max HP is not reduced when making Devil Pact.
skill_levels.4: Easier to get higher-quality skills when acquiring new skills.

dracoola.stat_boost: [All] Gears' Base Stats Increase +5% (at stars 1, 4, and 7)

skill_levels.1: Chance to absorb enemy HP during attacks.
skill_levels.2: Excess healing will be converted into damage on the next attack.
Enemy ATK is reduced for 5s after being unfrozen.
skill_levels.3: Attacks are imbued with the formidable ice element.
skill_levels.4: Summons Frost Meteor when attacking frozen enemies.

loki.stat_boost: [All] More damage VS players +5% (at stars 1, 4, and 7)

skill_levels.1: When moving, there is a chance to enter [Focus State] increasing ATK by 20% for 3s.
skill_levels.2: After entering [Focus State] 2 times, the next time this state is active, ATK SPD is increased by 30%, and duration is doubled.
skill_levels.3: When [Focus State] fades, there is 30% chance to enter this state again.
skill_levels.4: When battling players, if [Focus State] is active, there is a chance to gain immunity to all Control effects.

skill_levels.1: Mix sand into the elements. Elemental damage now also inflicts [Bleed] dealing 15% Bleed DMG every 0.15s.
skill_levels.2: Every 10 Bleed hits increases Elemental DMG by 5% for 5s (Max 5 stacks).
skill_levels.3: Against Burning or Poisoned enemies, +50% Bleed DMG dealt. Their Burn and Poison debuffs also tick 20% faster.
skill_levels.4: If enemy takes Lightning or Ice DMG, all remaining Bleed ticks are resolved instantly.

phynx.note: Widely considered the best resonance skill for PvP

skill_levels.1: The character's movement path will burn for an extended duration.
skill_levels.2: Main Weapon attacks have a chance to fire 2 [Cosmic Hoops] at target.
skill_levels.3: [Cosmic Hoops] gain [Fiery Path] effect and can track enemies.
skill_levels.4: Main Weapon attacks have a chance to fire 3 [Cosmic Hoops] at target, with a chance to chain-fire.

skill_levels.1: The higher the enemy's HP, the easier it is to land a CRIT.
skill_levels.2: After taking damage, gain +40% Crit Rate and +60% Crit DMG for 5s.
skill_levels.3: CRIT hits can insta-kill minions below 30% HP.
skill_levels.4: The farther the range, the higher the CRIT Rate, up to 15%.

skill_levels.1: Starts off with shield equal to 50% HP. When shield is active, elemental DMG +10%, CRIT DMG +30%.
skill_levels.2: Chance to summon dark energy orbs when enemies are hit; can pull hate. Energy orbs release energy rings to attack nearby enemies. Up to 3 orbs can be present.
skill_levels.3: When HP is below 50%, absorbs dark energy orbs on the map to restore shield HP (each orb restores 10% HP). Only triggers 1 time per game.
skill_levels.4: Dark energy orbs will form a binding field when destroyed. Enemies caught in the field will have their projectiles slowed and DMG taken increased. Field lasts 10s.

skill_levels.2: When moving, there is a chance to summon Mjolnir, homing in on enemies and dealing 100% DMG.
skill_levels.3: Attacks deal Lightning damage. Mjolnir inherits the hero's CRIT Rate. After dealing a critical hit, there is a chance to paralyze enemies for 0.5s.
skill_levels.4: When paralyzing enemies, fires 3 additional Mini-Mjolnirs.

skill_levels.1: Attacks are greatly enhanced by Fire.
skill_levels.2: For every 20 Fire hits, mark the enemy with the highest percentage HP on the field. After 1s, trigger a cross-shaped explosion and remove the mark, dealing 300% DMG and leaving behind a burning trail.
skill_levels.3: Trigger a cross-shaped explosion at your location after marking a target, dealing 300% DMG and leaving behind a burning trail. ATK +40% for 3s after marking.
skill_levels.4: Marking an enemy also Frightens them. Marked enemies suffer -50% ATK before exploding. Marked players suffer -35% ATK before exploding.

skill_levels.1: Summon 3 permanent [Monkey Mirages] after entering battle.
skill_levels.2: When attacking or taking damage, chance to summon 1 [Monkey Mirage] for 10s. Up to 6 [Monkey Mirages] can exist.
skill_levels.3: For each [Monkey Mirage] on the map, increase ATK, DMG REDUC, and Control RES by 3.5%.
skill_levels.4: [Monkey Mirages] have a chance to steal nearby enemy Hearts and Potions, increasing Wukong's ATK by 20% for 7s.

tracking_eye.name: Tracking Eye
tracking_eye.description: Your projectiles gain the ability to track enemies. Reduces DMG dealt by 10% (doesn't affect Sprites or elemental damage). Reduces main weapon and Strike projectile speed by 50%. Works best with Oracle Staff or when combined with Piercing Arrow or Energy Beam.

custom_facts.text: Guild donations: You can donate 5 times per day. The first donation is free, then costs increase by 20 gems each (free → 20 → 40 → 60 → 80). Donations are how guilds level up.
